finding_title: S3 bucket allows public read access
evidence_required: Bucket policy screenshot; S3 Block Public Access confirmation; access review record
recommended_action: Enable S3 Block Public Access, update bucket policy, remove public permissions and document closure evidence

evidence_required: Updated IAM policy; privileged access review; approval record
recommended_action: Remove unnecessary administrator permissions and replace with least-privilege role-based access

evidence_required: Inspector scan result; patch record; change ticket; post-remediation scan
recommended_action: Patch the affected instance, validate remediation with a new scan and record the change evidence

finding_title: Sensitive personal data detected in unencrypted storage
evidence_required: Macie finding export; encryption configuration; data classification review
recommended_action: Enable encryption, review data classification, restrict access and document privacy risk treatment

evidence_required: CloudTrail configuration screenshot; logging validation; monitoring rule evidence
recommended_action: Enable CloudTrail across all regions and validate that logs are delivered to a protected destination

finding_title: Security group allows inbound SSH from internet
evidence_required: Security group rule export; approved access exception; remediation screenshot
recommended_action: Restrict SSH access to approved IP ranges or remove direct SSH exposure

finding_title: Container image contains high severity vulnerabilities
evidence_required: Inspector vulnerability report; updated image digest; deployment record
recommended_action: Update vulnerable packages, rebuild the container image and redeploy using a validated image

finding_title: RDS database is not encrypted at rest
evidence_required: RDS encryption configuration; migration plan; risk acceptance or remediation record
recommended_action: Enable encryption at rest through approved migration or document temporary risk acceptance

finding_title: Access key has not been rotated for more than 180 days
evidence_required: Access key age report; rotation evidence; user confirmation
recommended_action: Rotate the access key, remove unused credentials and confirm key owner accountability

finding_title: S3 bucket versioning disabled for critical data
evidence_required: S3 versioning configuration; backup control evidence; change record
recommended_action: Enable versioning to support recovery, integrity and audit evidence retention

finding_title: GuardDuty not enabled in production account
evidence_required: GuardDuty configuration screenshot; account coverage report; monitoring validation
recommended_action: Enable GuardDuty and confirm findings are monitored through the security operations workflow

evidence_required: KMS key configuration; rotation setting screenshot; approval evidence
recommended_action: Enable automatic key rotation where appropriate and record encryption control evidence

evidence_required: Runtime version evidence; deployment record; test results
recommended_action: Upgrade the Lambda runtime, test the function and record deployment evidence

finding_title: Load balancer does not enforce HTTPS
evidence_required: Listener configuration; TLS policy evidence; validation screenshot
recommended_action: Redirect HTTP to HTTPS, apply approved TLS policy and validate external access

finding_title: Potential sensitive data shared with broad internal access
evidence_required: Macie finding export; access review record; approved sharing justification
recommended_action: Review access permissions, reduce broad access and document data-sharing approval
